name: Kawasaki Z400
engine: 399 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: The naked Ninja 400. Check the 2021 cam chain tensioner recall, which carries a do-not-ride warning.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2021 Z400 ABS bikes are in recall 20V774 because the cam chain tensioner may be too weak. Kawasaki says not to ride until it's replaced.
A-002.reason: A failed tensioner can wreck the engine. The repair is free.

recalls.what: Cam chain tensioner may be improperly heat-treated and fail. Do not ride until repaired.
